items.name: Cao DRL-ALNS-EVRP
items.mechanism: DQN guides ALNS choices around EVRP-specific destroy/repair; EV charging feasibility is treated as a first-class repair problem through FRVCP-style station/charge insertion.
items.adopt: Keep charging repair first-class and expose carbon timing as a controllable policy rather than only a generic destroy id.

items.name: Robbert Reijnen DR-ALNS
items.mechanism: The RL environment wraps ALNS state and operator rewards; useful as evidence that operator-selection DR alone is a narrow control surface.
items.adopt: Do not treat operator selection alone as the final DR surface; use it only as an A-group comparator.

items.name: N-Wouda ALNS
items.mechanism: Clean ALNS separates selection, acceptance, stopping, and operators; this repository's ALNS-Wouda wrapper is the strong non-DR baseline.
items.adopt: Use ALNS-Wouda as strong-method baseline and referee-compatible plain/strong comparator.

items.name: NeuOpt
items.mechanism: Learns local-search move effects, including feasible/infeasible routing regions and k-opt-style moves.
items.adopt: Pilot25 records it as evidence for moving beyond operator picking; full k-opt policy is out of scope for this overnight runner.

items.name: NLNS
items.mechanism: Learns repair/repair-order decisions inside large-neighborhood search rather than merely selecting a handcrafted destroy operator.
items.adopt: Pilot25 records it as the repair-learning target; overnight implementation focuses on the lower-risk carbon timing control surface.

items.name: POMO
items.mechanism: Uses multiple optima/starts with shared baseline to reduce variance for neural combinatorial optimization.
items.adopt: Keep the Pilot22-24 POMO shared-baseline rule for any learned policy updates.

items.name: GLOP / Learning to Delegate
items.mechanism: Uses decomposition/delegation for large-scale routing, explaining why direct monolithic training is expensive.
items.adopt: Report scale limits honestly; do not claim undertrained overnight runs prove impossibility.
